docs.main:
A guard that inspects the RAW byte after "a": trivia is not injected
inside a lookahead, so a space there must fail even though the skip
rule would otherwise consume it.

source:
## Semantics: C5, S1, S4, S5, S6, T1, M0, A1
grammar ConformanceSkipLookahead version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  ## Whitespace trivia.
  trivia = 1*" "
  ## A guard that inspects the RAW byte after "a": trivia is not injected
  ## inside a lookahead, so a space there must fail even though the skip
  ## rule would otherwise consume it.
  main = "a" !" " "c"

  skip = trivia

  entry main: main

  test main {
    accept "ac"
    accept "ac   "
    reject "a c"
    reject "a  c"
  }
}
